activity.notes: The historical Phrygian king Midas is identifiable with Mita of Mushki in Assyrian sources; 717 BCE is a directly attested year and is used as a representative historical point rather than converting later legendary regnal chronologies into exact dates.

sources.title: Phrygia, Gordion, and King Midas in the Late Eighth Century B.C. — Metropolitan Museum of Art
